# rms_tags (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of Teltonika RMS Tags.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rms_tags" "all" {}

output "tag_names" {
  value = data.rms_tags.all.tags[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifier for this data source.
- `tags` (Attributes List) List of tags. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
